svg.title: C2 case: a vertical flip changes reported SOC
svg.desc: Real retained formal RQ1 case. The up_down input map is the vertical mirror of original. Original SOC 12706, order SOC 11919, up_down SOC 16132. Strict-MR MD is 35.35 percent.
svg.text: C2 case: a vertical flip changes reported SOC
LaCAM* · run 4 · case 3,901 · Paris_2 source map · 128×128 grid, 100 agents
The map, obstacles, and all start/goal coordinates were flipped.
OF flag: the strict order and geometric-flip relations alone cross the 25% MD threshold.
No probe or obstacle SOC is needed for this comparison. These are solver outputs, not proven optimal costs.
Source: retained LaCAM* repeat_04/case_03901 input.map, input.scen, and result.txt files from the formal RQ1 batch.
The maps are actual saved inputs; no individual-agent path causality is inferred from the 100-agent trajectories.
